messages:
sophia_csm: Kicking off BlueHarbor onboarding. Top-level goals: staging integration, security review, and a pilot load run within 14 days. Quick roll call + biggest risks?

raj_csm: Roll call: Claire (BH PM), Omar (eng lead), Lena (data privacy), Tom (ops). They asked for a daily 15m check-in first week.

elliot_pm: Timeline: client wants a pilot decision at day 14. Plan = standups days 1-5, then Tue/Thu syncs. Will draft a simple 14-day milestone doc.

sasha_eng: Perf note: baseline p50 ~220ms on redwood-small; p95 depends on batching/context. If they push longer contexts we may need Dedicated. I'll post perf options today.

mina_sec: Security flags: EU data residency for PII, retention window limits, and an SSO requirement. Need DPA + minimal change to their dataflow.

raj_csm: Renewal risk items: single executive POC, bespoke transformation layer they want inside our runtime, and usage spike risk during pilot marketing. Recommend sales + legal ikut.

sophia_csm: Success criteria to propose: (a) staging requests authenticated and passing smoke tests, (b) security checklist completed with signoff, (c) runbook + cost controls shared and BH can run basic tests.

elliot_pm: Enablement cadence: Day2 API + auth walkthrough, Day5 integration clinic (hands-on), Day9 ops/cost controls, Day12 runbook dry-run.

sasha_eng: Quick curl for staging to share with BH engs:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize: sales notes"}]}'
```

onboard-bot: ACTION CREATED: #2107 - "BlueHarbor DPA + SSO options" assigned to mina_sec, due 2024-12-02.

raj_csm: Feedback capture: propose short daily pulse (3 Qs) for first 5 days + shared doc for integration issues. I'll create the pulse and the #blueharbor-feedback channel.

sophia_csm: Action list so far: sasha -> perf matrix + sample; mina -> DPA/SSO options; raj -> feedback channel + pulse; elliot -> 14-day milestone doc + invites.

mina_sec: Note on EU residency: for pilot we can route to eu-hosted region; Private deploy if they need phys isolation. Will confirm costs/lead times.

elliot_pm: Also flagging billing cadence vs reserved capacity lead time. If they want Dedicated for latency guarantees that could add procurement delay. Loop sales now.

sophia_csm: Agree. @elliot_pm add sales@ to the calendar invite and include procurement note in milestone doc.

elliot_pm: Will do. First standup tomorrow 9:30 PT. I'll post the agenda and milestone doc link in the event and here.

sophia_csm: Thanks everyone 44d
